list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: List the company's users with their availability status, roles, time zone and wrap-up time, oldest first unless ordered otherwise.

from.description: Only users created at or after this UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Only users created at or before this UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

get_user.title: Get a user
get_user.description: Read one user -- name, email, roles, availability, time zone and wrap-up time -- by id or email address.

id.description: User id (or email address, for reads).

create_user.title: Create a user
create_user.description: Add a user to the company. Aircall emails them an invitation and they must confirm before they can use Aircall.

email.description: Email, unique across Aircall. An invitation is sent to it.

availability_status.description: available, custom (follow working hours) or unavailable.

role_ids.description: Roles: owner, supervisor, admin or agent; defaults to agent.

wrap_up_time.description: Seconds of wrap-up time after each call, for agents (default 0).

inviter_user_id.description: Id of the admin shown as having sent the invitation.

update_user.title: Update a user
update_user.description: Change a user's name, roles, wrap-up time or availability -- for example to mark them unavailable from a calendar or workforce tool.

availability_status.description: available, custom (follow working hours) or unavailable.

role_ids.description: Roles: owner, supervisor, admin or agent.

wrap_up_time.description: Seconds of wrap-up time after each call, for agents.

substatus.description: Why the user is unavailable, when availability_status is unavailable.

list_user_numbers.title: List a user's numbers
list_user_numbers.description: List the Aircall numbers a user is assigned to.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

delete_user.title: Delete a user
delete_user.description: Delete a user and every piece of data associated with them. Nothing is recoverable.

list_user_availabilities.title: List user availabilities
list_user_availabilities.description: List every user's live availability as the dashboard activity feed shows it: available, offline, do_not_disturb, in_call or after_call_work.

from.description: Only users created at or after this UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Only users created at or before this UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

get_user_availability.title: Get a user's availability
get_user_availability.description: Read one user's live availability: available, offline, do_not_disturb, in_call or after_call_work.

start_outbound_call.title: Start an outbound call
start_outbound_call.description: Make a user's desktop Aircall Workspace place a call right away from one of their numbers (click-to-call). The user must be available, not on a call, and assigned to the number.

number_id.description: Id of the Aircall number to call from; the user must belong to it.

dial_number.title: Pre-fill a number to dial
dial_number.description: Put a number in a user's Aircall Workspace dialer so they can choose the line and start the call themselves (click-to-dial). Nothing is dialled automatically.

list_teams.title: List teams
list_teams.description: List the company's teams with their members.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

get_team.title: Get a team
get_team.description: Read one team with its name and the users in it.

create_team.title: Create a team
create_team.description: Create a team; add members with add_user_to_team. Teams are used for call distribution.

name.description: Team name, unique in the company, up to 64 characters.

delete_team.title: Delete a team
delete_team.description: Delete a team and remove it from every number's call distribution. Its users and calls are kept.

add_user_to_team.title: Add a user to a team
add_user_to_team.description: Add one user to a team, so they ring when calls are distributed to it.

remove_user_from_team.title: Remove a user from a team
remove_user_from_team.description: Remove one user from a team; their calls are kept.

list_calls.title: List calls
list_calls.description: List calls with direction, status, duration, number, user, contact, tags and comments, filtered by creation time. Capped at 10,000 results, so narrow with from and to.

from.description: Only calls created at or after this UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Only calls created at or before this UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

fetch_contact.description: True to include the contact's details.

fetch_short_urls.description: True to include 3-hour short URLs for the recording and voicemail.

fetch_call_timeline.description: True to include the IVR options the caller selected (calls from the last two months).

fetch_aiva_conv.description: True to include the AI Voice Agents that handled the call.

search_calls.title: Search calls
search_calls.description: Find calls by user, phone number, direction, tags and time. Only the last six months are searchable.

from.description: Only calls created at or after this UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Only calls created at or before this UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

user_id.description: Only calls made or received by this user.

phone_number.description: Only calls from or to this number.

tags.description: Tag ids; calls must carry all of them.

fetch_contact.description: True to include the contact's details.

fetch_short_urls.description: True to include 3-hour short URLs for the recording and voicemail.

fetch_call_timeline.description: True to include the IVR options the caller selected (calls from the last two months).

fetch_aiva_conv.description: True to include the AI Voice Agents that handled the call.

get_call.title: Get a call
get_call.description: Read one call: direction, status, timestamps, duration, recording and voicemail links (valid one hour), comments, tags and participants.

fetch_contact.description: True to include the contact's details.

fetch_short_urls.description: True to include 3-hour short URLs for the recording and voicemail.

fetch_call_timeline.description: True to include the IVR options the caller selected (calls from the last two months).

fetch_aiva_conv.description: True to include the AI Voice Agents that handled the call.

transfer_call.title: Transfer a call
transfer_call.description: Cold-transfer a live call to one user, one team (with a dispatching strategy) or an external number -- exactly one of the three. External transfers only work on unanswered inbound calls, and a transfer does not fall back to anyone else.

number.description: External number to transfer to, E.164; only for unanswered inbound calls.

dispatching_strategy.description: How a team is rung: simultaneous (default), random or longest_idle.

comment_call.title: Comment on a call
comment_call.description: Add a note to a call. A call holds at most five, and notes can never be edited or deleted.

tag_call.title: Tag a call
tag_call.description: Add tags to a call by tag id; list_tags gives the ids.

archive_call.title: Archive a call
archive_call.description: Set a call's archived flag. It no longer affects Aircall Workspace, which works per conversation; it only changes the flag on the record.

unarchive_call.title: Unarchive a call
unarchive_call.description: Clear a call's archived flag. It no longer affects Aircall Workspace; it only changes the flag on the record.

pause_call_recording.title: Pause a call recording
pause_call_recording.description: Pause live recording on an ongoing call, e.g. while card details are read out.

resume_call_recording.title: Resume a call recording
resume_call_recording.description: Resume live recording on an ongoing call after pause_call_recording.

delete_call_recording.title: Delete a call recording
delete_call_recording.description: Permanently delete a call's recording, and with it the transcript and every AI insight (summary, topics, action items, sentiment). Recordings can take 24 hours to arrive; retry later if there is none yet.

delete_call_voicemail.title: Delete a call voicemail
delete_call_voicemail.description: Permanently delete the voicemail left on a call.

send_insight_card.title: Show an insight card
send_insight_card.description: Display a card of custom data to the agent on an ongoing call -- a title, short text lines with optional links, and user cards. Cards vanish when the call ends.

contents.description: Lines of the card, under 10KB in total: {type: title, text, link?}, {type: shortText, text, label?, link?} or {type: user, label, user_id}.

get_call_transcription.title: Get a call transcription
get_call_transcription.description: Read a finished call's transcript as utterances with speaker type, user or phone number, timings and language. mode realtime returns what the agent saw live.

mode.description: async (post-call transcription, the default) or realtime (what the agent saw live).

get_call_sentiments.title: Get call sentiments
get_call_sentiments.description: Read the sentiment (POSITIVE, NEUTRAL or NEGATIVE) Aircall scored for each participant of a call.

get_call_predicted_csat.title: Get predicted CSAT
get_call_predicted_csat.description: Read the customer satisfaction score Aircall predicts for a call, with its drivers.

get_call_topics.title: Get call topics
get_call_topics.description: Read the key topics discussed on a call.

get_call_summary.title: Get a call summary
get_call_summary.description: Read the AI-generated summary of a finished call.

get_call_custom_summary.title: Get a custom summary result
get_call_custom_summary.description: Read a call's custom summary -- the fields your summary template asks for, AI-generated or edited. Needs AI Assist Pro.

get_call_action_items.title: Get call action items
get_call_action_items.description: Read the action items from a call, AI-generated or added by agents.

get_call_playbook_result.title: Get a playbook result
get_call_playbook_result.description: Read how closely a call followed its playbook: the adherence score and a result per topic. Needs AI Assist Pro.

fetch_playbook.description: True to include the playbook definition.

get_call_evaluations.title: Get call evaluations
get_call_evaluations.description: Read a call's quality-assurance evaluations: scorecard, overall and per-category scores, per-question answers and feedback.

list_trackers.title: List trackers
list_trackers.description: List the conversation trackers configured for the company -- keyword rules that flag calls -- with their filters.

get_tracker.title: Get a tracker
get_tracker.description: Read a tracker and the calls currently matching it, filterable by time (UNIX milliseconds), direction, agents and lines, token-paginated.

start_time.description: Earliest matched call, UNIX milliseconds; defaults to 7 days before end_time.

end_time.description: Latest matched call, UNIX milliseconds; defaults to now.

limit.description: Matched calls per page, up to 50 (default 20).

output.description: The tracker with its matching calls.

get_dialer_campaign.title: Get a dialer campaign
get_dialer_campaign.description: Read a user's active Power Dialer campaign. A user has at most one.

create_dialer_campaign.title: Create a dialer campaign
create_dialer_campaign.description: Start a Power Dialer campaign for a user with a list of numbers to call. A user can have only one active campaign.

phone_numbers.description: Numbers to call, at least one valid number.

delete_dialer_campaign.title: Delete a dialer campaign
delete_dialer_campaign.description: Delete a user's Power Dialer campaign and all its numbers.

list_dialer_campaign_numbers.title: List dialer campaign numbers
list_dialer_campaign_numbers.description: List the numbers in a user's Power Dialer campaign and whether each has been called.

add_dialer_campaign_numbers.title: Add dialer campaign numbers
add_dialer_campaign_numbers.description: Append numbers to a user's active Power Dialer campaign; they appear in Aircall Workspace.

phone_numbers.description: Numbers to append, at least one valid number.

delete_dialer_campaign_number.title: Remove a dialer campaign number
delete_dialer_campaign_number.description: Remove one number from a user's Power Dialer campaign.

list_numbers.title: List numbers
list_numbers.description: List the company's Aircall numbers with country, time zone, recording setting, priority, users and music and messages.

from.description: Only numbers created at or after this UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Only numbers created at or before this UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

get_number.title: Get a number
get_number.description: Read one Aircall number with its users, recording setting, priority and audio.

update_number.title: Update a number
update_number.description: Change a number's name, availability (its first Time Rule widget), call recording, routing priority, or music and messages.

availability_status.description: Updates the first Time Rule widget of the call flow: open, custom or closed.

live_recording_activated.description: True to record inbound and outbound calls on this number.

messages.description: Audio URLs to set, each a public URL: welcome (first Audio widget), waiting (music on hold), ivr (first IVR prompt), voicemail (every Voicemail widget), after_hours (first voicemail or audio in the 'at any other time' branch), ringing_tone (every waiting-experience file).

get_number_registration_status.title: Get messaging registration status
get_number_registration_status.description: Read a number's messaging compliance status: A2P 10DLC registration in the US, or toll-free verification in the US and Canada.

list_whatsapp_templates.title: List WhatsApp templates
list_whatsapp_templates.description: List the WhatsApp templates on a WhatsApp-registered number, by approval status and category. Template ids go in templateParams.

status.description: Approval status, e.g. APPROVED, REJECTED, PAUSED, PENDING.

get_whatsapp_line_status.title: Get WhatsApp line status
get_whatsapp_line_status.description: Read a number's WhatsApp registration: online or not, whether it can send, its Meta messaging tier, quality rating and business verification.

send_message.title: Send an SMS in the inbox
send_message.description: Text someone from an SMS-capable number, stored in the agents' conversation so they can continue it. Not for bulk or automated sending -- use send_message_skipping_inbox.

agent_id.description: User the message is sent as.

send_group_message.title: Send a group SMS in the inbox
send_group_message.description: Text a group of up to nine people from an SMS-capable number, stored in the group conversation for agents to continue.

participants.description: Recipient numbers, E.164; up to 9 besides the sender.

agent_id.description: User the message is sent as.

send_whatsapp_message.title: Send a WhatsApp message in the inbox
send_whatsapp_message.description: Send a WhatsApp text (inside the 24-hour window) or template (to open a conversation) that agents see and can continue.

agent_id.description: User the message is sent as.

text.description: Text, up to 4,096 characters, only inside an open 24-hour window. Exclusive with templateParams.

template_params.description: Template send, needed outside the 24-hour window: {id, body: [{key, value}], header: {...}}. Exclusive with text.

list_sms_templates.title: List SMS templates
list_sms_templates.description: List the company's SMS templates across all agents, optionally searching names and bodies.

search.description: Text to match in template names and bodies.

configure_number_messaging.title: Configure a number for API messaging
configure_number_messaging.description: Register a number for high-volume API sending over SMS or WhatsApp, with a callback URL for delivery updates and inbound messages. Once configured, the number can no longer message from the Aircall apps.

callback_url.description: URL receiving delivery updates and inbound messages for this number.

output.description: The configuration, with the token callbacks carry.

get_number_messaging_configuration.title: Get a number's API messaging configuration
get_number_messaging_configuration.description: Read a number's API messaging configuration: channel and callback URL.

delete_number_messaging_configuration.title: Delete a number's API messaging configuration
delete_number_messaging_configuration.description: Remove a number's API messaging configuration, returning its messaging to the Aircall apps.

send_message_skipping_inbox.title: Send an SMS or MMS outside the inbox
send_message_skipping_inbox.description: Send a text or MMS from a number configured for API messaging, without storing it in any agent inbox -- for notifications and automated sends.

media_url.description: Public URLs of media to send as MMS.

send_group_message_skipping_inbox.title: Send a group message outside the inbox
send_group_message_skipping_inbox.description: Send a group text or MMS (one or the other) from a number configured for API messaging, outside the agent inbox.

participants.description: Recipient numbers, E.164; up to 9 besides the sender.

body.description: Message text; send either body or mediaUrl, not both.

media_url.description: Public media URLs; send either body or mediaUrl, not both.

send_whatsapp_message_skipping_inbox.title: Send a WhatsApp message outside the inbox
send_whatsapp_message_skipping_inbox.description: Send a WhatsApp text, media or template message from a line configured for API messaging, outside the agent inbox. Needs the whatsapp_messaging add-on; text outside the 24-hour window fails asynchronously.

line_id.description: WhatsApp-capable number id, configured for API sending.

text.description: Text, up to 4,096 characters, only inside an open 24-hour window.

template_params.description: Template send: {id, body: [{key, value}], header: {...}}. Exclusive with text and mediaUrl.

list_contacts.title: List contacts
list_contacts.description: List the company's shared contacts with their phone numbers and emails. Contacts synced from CRM integrations are not included. Capped at 10,000 results.

from.description: Only contacts created at or after this UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Only contacts created at or before this UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

search_contacts.title: Search contacts
search_contacts.description: Find shared contacts by phone number or email, optionally within a creation window.

from.description: Only contacts created at or after this UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Only contacts created at or before this UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

phone_number.description: A phone number the contact has.

email.description: An email address the contact has.

get_contact.title: Get a contact
get_contact.description: Read one shared contact with its phone numbers and emails.

create_contact.title: Create a contact
create_contact.description: Create a contact shared across the company; at least one phone number is required. Repeating the same request creates a duplicate.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers, each {label, value}; at least one, at most 20.

emails.description: Email addresses, each {label, value}; at most 20.

update_contact.title: Update a contact
update_contact.description: Change a contact's name, company or information. Phone numbers and emails have their own tools.

delete_contact.title: Delete a contact
delete_contact.description: Delete a shared contact from the company. Only shared contacts can be deleted.

add_contact_phone_number.title: Add a phone number to a contact
add_contact_phone_number.description: Add one phone number to a contact, up to 20.

value.description: The phone number; it is normalized before storing.

update_contact_phone_number.title: Update a contact's phone number
update_contact_phone_number.description: Change one of a contact's phone numbers; value must always be sent.

value.description: The phone number, required on every update.

delete_contact_phone_number.title: Remove a contact's phone number
delete_contact_phone_number.description: Remove one phone number from a contact, leaving the contact itself.

add_contact_email.title: Add an email to a contact
add_contact_email.description: Add one email address to a contact, up to 20.

update_contact_email.title: Update a contact's email
update_contact_email.description: Change one of a contact's email addresses; value must always be sent.

value.description: The email address, required on every update.

delete_contact_email.title: Remove a contact's email
delete_contact_email.description: Remove one email address from a contact.

list_tags.title: List tags
list_tags.description: List the company's call tags with their names and colours.

get_tag.title: Get a tag
get_tag.description: Read one call tag with its name, colour and description.

create_tag.title: Create a tag
create_tag.description: Create a call tag with a unique name and a hex colour.

name.description: Tag name, unique in the company.

color.description: Colour as a hex code, e.g. #00B388.

update_tag.title: Update a tag
update_tag.description: Rename or recolour a call tag; both name and colour must be sent.

name.description: Tag name, unique in the company.

delete_tag.title: Delete a tag
delete_tag.description: Delete a call tag and remove it from every call.

list_webhooks.title: List webhooks
list_webhooks.description: List webhooks with their URL, events, active state and signing token.

order.description: Sort by creation date: asc (default) or desc.

get_webhook.title: Get a webhook
get_webhook.description: Read one webhook with its URL, events, active state and token.

webhook_id.description: Webhook id (the UUID webhook_id; a legacy numeric id also works).

create_webhook.title: Create a webhook
create_webhook.description: Subscribe a URL to call, user, contact, number, message or AI events. A company can have up to 100 webhooks.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the events.

events.description: Event names such as call.created, call.ended, message.received, contact.updated; empty subscribes to every event.

output.description: The webhook, with its token for verifying payloads.

update_webhook.title: Update a webhook
update_webhook.description: Change a webhook's URL, name or events, or re-activate one Aircall disabled after failures. Without events_action, events replaces the list -- and omitting it subscribes to everything.

events_action.description: add or remove to change the listed events against the existing ones; omit to replace the whole list.

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the events.

events.description: Event names. Without events_action they replace the list, and an empty list means every event.

active.description: True to re-activate a webhook Aircall disabled, false to pause it.

delete_webhook.title: Delete a webhook
delete_webhook.description: Delete a webhook; Aircall stops sending it events.

get_company.title: Get the company
get_company.description: Read the company's name and how many users and numbers it has.

ping.title: Ping the API
ping.description: Check that the credentials work. Returns a pong and nothing else.

trigger_ai_voice_agent_call.title: Trigger an AI Voice Agent call
trigger_ai_voice_agent_call.description: Have an outbound AI Voice Agent phone someone -- reminders, follow-ups, surveys, qualification. The call is queued and retried within the expiration window; context must fill every {{variable}} in the agent's messages or the call is rejected.

agent_id.description: Outbound Voice Agent id, from the agent's Outbound Call Workflow tab.

contact_phone.description: Number to call with country code, e.g. +15551234567.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this request, e.g. campaign-2026-09-13-customer-42. Never reuse one, even after a failure.

context.description: Values for every {{variable}} in the agent's first and voicemail messages. UTC datetimes need a timezone key, e.g. America/New_York.

expiration_seconds.description: How long to keep retrying while at the concurrency limit, 60-86400 (default 3600).

create_analytics_export.title: Export an analytics report
create_analytics_export.description: Start an asynchronous CSV export of an analytics report (call history, user status history or user activity metrics) over a date window with filters. Poll get_analytics_export for the download link. Needs Analytics+.

input.description: {reportName, filter, options?, exportOptions?}. reportName is CALLS_HISTORY, USER_STATUS_HISTORY or one of the USER_ACTIVITY_* reports. filter needs dateFilter ({relative: TODAY|YESTERDAY|THIS_WEEK|LAST_WEEK|THIS_MONTH|LAST_MONTH} or {absoluteRange: {fromDate, toDate}}) and timezone, and can narrow by userIDs, teamIDs, lineIDs, tagIDs, callTypes, duration and more.

get_analytics_export.title: Get an analytics export
get_analytics_export.description: Check an analytics export job; once COMPLETED it carries a time-limited download URL for the CSV (zipped for large exports).

update_number_music_and_messages.title: Update a number's music and messages
update_number_music_and_messages.description: Replace a number's audio -- welcome message, hold music, IVR prompt, voicemail greeting, after-hours message or ringing tone -- with files at public URLs.

messages.description: Audio URLs to set, each a public URL: welcome (first Audio widget), waiting (music on hold), ivr (first IVR prompt), voicemail (every Voicemail widget), after_hours (first voicemail or audio in the 'at any other time' branch), ringing_tone (every waiting-experience file).

output.description: The number with its updated messages.
